study type: Retrospective cohort study and time-trend analysis
outcome: Infant mortality from perinatal CNS injury
cohort: The study analyzed data of 559,164 newborns in Lithuania from 1997 to 2014, including both term and preterm births.
finding: The frequency of perinatal CNS injury in term newborns in Lithuania decreased almost two times from 1997 to 2014, and the rate of infant mortality from perinatal CNS injury decreased by more than four times during the same period.
mod_finding: The largest decrease of CNS injury was seen after caesarean birth and breech delivery.
